title: User-scoped and resource-aware agent cluster workflows
summary: Agent skills apply account-owned write rules and appropriate LSF scheduling when interacting with shared cluster environments.

dates.note: Exact project start/end dates remain unknown. Direct local source/history review on 2026-10-29 supplements the supplied October 5 snapshot and separately dated owner statements. Commit milestones and review dates are not project starts or release dates.

facts.text: Established cluster-skill operating rules to write within Michael’s user-owned areas, account for other cluster users and use LSF where appropriate rather than overloading shared login hosts.
Implemented run-owned temporary paths, credentials kept out of command arguments, ownership checks and preservation of LSF replay constraints in supporting cluster tools.
These are user-scoped workflow policies and controls, not proof of an OS-enforced sandbox, company-wide identity platform, universal write prevention or LLM token/cost governance.
